effectSummary.ko: 제자리에서 마력을 집중해 기본 마나 회복 속도의 10배로 회복한다. 이동하거나 공격하면 자동으로 종료되며, 피격만으로는 종료되지 않는다. 쿨타임이 없다.
effectSummary.en: Stand still and channel mana at ten times the base regeneration rate. Moving or attacking cancels the channel; taking damage alone does not. No cooldown.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: HELLSCRIPT Mage skill icon, M13 Mana Reclaim / 마력 회수, active ability.
Primary request: Create ONE new independent 1024x1024 PNG icon with REAL NATIVE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, not a checkerboard picture. Isolate a stationary blue arcane core held between two still dark-robed mage hands. Three broad tapered cobalt-and-cyan energy ribbons curve INWARD and disappear into the bright, stable central core, clearly communicating inward gathering, calm concentration and restoration. The hands remain steady; no outgoing bolt, explosion, radial attack, shield, invulnerability or motion trail. This ability has no cooldown, restores mana at ten times base regeneration while standing still, cancels on moving or attacking, and persists through taking damage. Equipment synergy DES_LM44 supports warding and mana reclaim; keep the main subject mana concentration rather than a physical item.
Style/medium: dark gothic painterly game art, sculptural large forms, restrained brush texture, weathered charcoal cloth, cool pale-blue edge highlights, rich dark shadows, a luminous saturated blue focal core. Match the reference equipment's somber tactile shading without copying any existing art. Readable at 64px.
Composition: one cohesive subject, centered, all visible material and glow entirely within central 76 percent of the canvas (between 123 and 901 pixels both axes), wide completely transparent margins. Clear silhouette, two or three major forms, minimal tiny particles. Do not print names or IDs.
Transparency: return a 1024x1024 RGBA PNG preserving actual alpha. Both surrounding space and empty gaps between hands and ribbons are fully transparent. Antialiased clean edges, no matte or halo. Absolutely no environment, solid backdrop, checkerboard, floor, ground plane, pedestal, cast shadow, UI panel, frame, border, circle enclosure, text, runes resembling letters, digits, logo or watermark.

readability64.ko: 고정된 두 손 사이로 푸른 흐름이 안쪽의 핵에 모입니다. 발사체나 무적 방패로 보이지 않습니다.
readability64.en: Blue streams converge inward between steady hands. The form reads as gathering, not a projectile or invulnerability barrier.

edges.ko: 원본과 밝은·어두운 바탕의 256px 검수에서 불투명 매트, 배경 무늬, 잘린 주형태를 발견하지 못했습니다. 가장자리의 매우 낮은 알파 픽셀은 자동 경고로 남깁니다.
edges.en: Native output and 256px light/dark inspection showed no opaque matte, backdrop pattern or clipped main form. Very low-alpha border pixels remain recorded warnings.

distinctness.ko: 64px 비교판에서 큰 형태와 주효과로 다른 담당 항목과 구별됩니다.
distinctness.en: The major silhouette and effect remain distinct among this production group in the actual64px contact sheets.
